create_RequestLogger: create a RequestLogger instance with a max_log_len parameter to limit logged output length
log_request_inputs: log request inputs including prompt, token ids, params, and lora request details to debug and info levels
log_request_outputs: log generated response outputs with token ids, finish reason, and optional streaming metadata
test_RequestLogger: test the RequestLogger class to verify debug and info logging behavior with truncation
review_log_inputs: review the log_inputs method that logs request details at debug level and params at info level
